mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT overtime_id as overtimeId, employee_id as employeeId, work_date as workDate, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, reason as reason, approval_status as approvalStatus, reject_reason as rejectReason FROM overtime_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY start_time DESC, overtime_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT overtime_id as overtimeId, employee_id as employeeId, work_date as workDate, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, reason as reason, approval_status as approvalStatus, reject_reason as rejectReason FROM overtime_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND work_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY start_time ASC, overtime_id ASC

SELECT overtime_id as overtimeId, employee_id as employeeId, work_date as workDate, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, reason as reason, approval_status as approvalStatus, reject_reason as rejectReason FROM overtime_request WHERE overtime_id = #{overtimeId}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) as rejectedCount FROM overtime_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
